title: The Monthly Label Error
brief: For 4 months in a row, Meridian Foods has found one packing run with the wrong best-before date format on the label. Each time the run was relabeled. Corrective action CA-201 says "operator retrained". You have 12 visit points to interview staff and reach a system cause.

actions.label: General condition of the area
actions.note: Nothing of note for the purpose of this visit.

actions.label: Planner: what differs about the affected runs
A staff member: anything else to mention
actions.note: The staff member has nothing further to add on this topic.

actions.label: Engineer: what happens at month end
Older records for this area
actions.note: The older records show nothing relevant to this visit.

actions.label: Notices and signs in the area
actions.note: The notices are current and not relevant to this visit.

evidence.text: CA-201 cause: "operator error". Action: "operator retrained". Closed with no check; the error recurred in months 3 and 4.
evidence.whyItMatters: Corrective action must remove the cause and be checked. Retraining one person does not address a system cause.
evidence.missedExplanation: Read whether the action was checked and whether the problem returned.

evidence.text: Error records: all 4 errors happened on the first run of a new month, for 2 export customers.
evidence.whyItMatters: The pattern points to the cause. Analyzing it is the missing step.

evidence.text: Operator: "I select the customer code and the date fills in. I don't type it." The operator reported 2 of the 4 errors.
evidence.whyItMatters: The operator follows the method and reports problems.
evidence.falseFindingNote: The operator is following the method. Not a person issue.

evidence.text: Labeler L-2 screen: the date format is stored per product, not per customer; export customers need format DD.MM.YYYY, set manually by a lead each month.
evidence.whyItMatters: Controlled production needs settings that ensure the correct output. A manual monthly step without a check invites errors.
evidence.missedExplanation: Ask where a setting is stored and who changes it.

evidence.text: Planner: "Export orders for 2 customers start each month; other months are domestic only."
evidence.falseFindingNote: The planner describes the schedule accurately.

evidence.text: Customer label specifications for the 2 export customers (specs LS-14 and LS-15) were never entered into the labeler master data; they exist only as PDF files.
evidence.whyItMatters: Customer requirements must be reviewed and built into the process that delivers them.
evidence.missedExplanation: Check that customer requirements reach the system that applies them.

evidence.text: Labeler software was updated 5 months ago (change SW-12); the update reset per-customer formats to the default. No post-change check is recorded.
evidence.whyItMatters: After a change, outputs should be checked to confirm the change did not cause problems.
evidence.missedExplanation: Ask what changed shortly before the problem began.

evidence.text: Engineer: "At month end the lead re-enters the export format by hand. There's no second check and no checklist." (note 6)
evidence.whyItMatters: A critical manual step needs a defined method and check.
evidence.missedExplanation: Ask exactly how the monthly step is done.

evidence.text: Training records: all labeler operators are trained on the current procedure.
evidence.whyItMatters: Competence records are current; training is not the gap.
evidence.falseFindingNote: Training is current. Retraining was not the answer.

evidence.text: Label verification camera MV-2 checks the barcode only, not the date format.
evidence.whyItMatters: Extending the existing check to the date would detect errors before release.
evidence.missedExplanation: Ask what the inspection system actually checks.

evidence.text: Line speed board shows normal speed for the affected runs.
evidence.whyItMatters: Speed is not linked to the errors.
evidence.falseFindingNote: Speed is normal. Not a cause.

evidence.whyItMatters: Breaks are not linked to the errors.
evidence.falseFindingNote: Normal breaks are not a cause.

decisions.prompt: Which statement best describes the system cause?
options: Operators make mistakes at month end
A software update reset customer formats, export specifications were never built into master data, and a manual monthly re-entry has no check
The customers change their requirements too often
decisions.rationale: The cause lies in master data, change control, and an unchecked manual step.

containment: Check the date format on the first export run of each month until the fix is in place
correction: Relabel affected product under the existing authorized rework
cause: Export date formats are not held in master data, the software change reset formats, and the manual step has no check
corrective: Enter LS-14 and LS-15 into labeler master data, verify settings after software changes, and extend camera MV-2 to check the date format
Reopen CA-201 with the system cause
effectiveness: Track export label errors for six months, target zero

debriefText.found: You moved from "operator error" to master data, change, and inspection.
debriefText.missed: When an error follows a calendar pattern, look for manual steps tied to that date.
debriefText.falseFinding: Speed and breaks were not causes.
